pages.title: About
pages.content:
Kantei Valuers opened in 2011 at 27 Merchants Row, Dublin 2. Orla Brennan had been a panel valuer for a lender's commercial loan book, and she started the practice so that one valuer would stay with an instruction from the site hour to the signature.

Nine people work from the office and seven of them meet the instruction: Orla Brennan, Kwame Asante, Inès Moreau, Tobias Reinholt, Priya Nair, Daniel Kowalczyk and Aoife Gallagher.

pages.title: Instructions
pages.content: We accept two kinds of instruction. A lender instruction is for a bank or lender that needs the market value of a commercial property offered as loan security. An owner or seller instruction is for an owner, buyer or seller who needs a value before a sale, a purchase, a lease renewal or a rent review, or for company accounts.

pages.title: Site hour
pages.content: One property takes sixty minutes on site, booked Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 16:00. The hour has four parts: the plan, the tape, the condition and the documents. A building over 5,000 m² has a second hour at no extra fee.

pages.title: Report
pages.content: The signed written report is about twenty pages with plans and photographs in the appendices. It follows within ten working days of the site hour, once the documents are received.

pages.title: Fees
pages.content: Every fee is in EUR, excluding VAT. The fee is fixed in the written quote before the site hour, travel within 150 km of Dublin is included, the invoice is sent with the signed report and is payable in 30 days, and the fee never depends on the figure.

pages.title: Rent Notes
pages.content: Rent Notes is one page a quarter, by email: the lettings and sales the practice compared that quarter, described in words and never as a forecast. The first issue goes out in January 2027. This page is the early-access list.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Tell us the address, the purpose and the date you need the figure by. Aoife Gallagher sends a written fee quote within one working day.

Kantei Valuers, 27 Merchants Row, Dublin 2, Ireland. Telephone +353 1 000 0611, Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30 Irish time. Email instruct@kantei.example.

pages.title: Thanks
pages.content: Thank you. Aoife will write back within one working day. The office is open Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content: We use the details you send only to answer your request and to carry out the instruction. We do not sell them and we do not share them for marketing.

pages.title: Terms
pages.content: The fee is fixed in the written quote before the site hour. Travel within 150 km of Dublin is included. The invoice is sent with the signed report and is payable in 30 days. The fee never depends on the figure, and no figure is promised before the site hour.

categories.name: Instructions
categories.description: Recent instructions, told after the fact.

posts.title: A corner shop and the flat above, valued for a refinance
posts.excerpt: A lender asked for a market value for a refinance, and the lease plan showed a rear yard the owner had forgotten was let.
posts.content:
A lender asked for a market value of a corner shop with a flat above, offered as security for a refinance. The site hour was booked for 08:00 on a weekday.

On the site hour the lease plan showed a rear yard the owner had forgotten was let. The yard was measured with the shop and the flat, and the tenure section of the report set out who held it.

The signed report went back to the lender in eight working days.

posts.title: Two floors in Kilkenny, one let and one empty
posts.excerpt: An owner instructed us before a sale of a two-storey office; each floor was valued on its own.
posts.content:
An owner instructed us before a sale of a two-storey office on a quiet street in Kilkenny.

The two floors were measured separately. One floor was let and one was vacant, and each was valued on its own. The report set out the areas, the lease on the let floor and the evidence used for both.

posts.title: A warehouse lease renewal in Naas
posts.excerpt: A letter of opinion for the renewal talks, comparing five lettings within 20 km.
posts.content:
A landlord asked for a lease renewal opinion on a warehouse in Naas, instructed for the tenant's landlord.

There was no full report. The letter compared five lettings within 20 km and said why each one was used. It was written for the renewal talks and is not a forecast of the rent.

posts.title: Rent Notes: the first issue goes out in January 2027
posts.excerpt: One page a quarter, by email. The first issue is in January 2027.
posts.content:
Rent Notes is one printed-style page a quarter, by email: the lettings and sales the practice compared that quarter, described in words and never as a forecast.

The first issue goes out in January 2027. The Rent Notes page is the early-access list.

posts.title: What to send before a site hour
posts.excerpt: Leases and side letters, rent roll, title plan, service-charge budget, insurance schedule and planning permissions.
posts.content:
The site hour goes best when the papers are close at hand. We ask for leases and side letters, the rent roll, the title plan, the service-charge budget, the building insurance schedule and any planning permissions.

Bring the lease plan to the site hour. The rest can follow the same day. The ten working days to the signed report start once the documents are received.
